newsitem.title: USA: N.J. mayor continues fight against bonds -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. mayor continues fight against bonds -- paper.

text.p: Edison, N.J., Mayor George Spadoro asked the state Supreme Court to reconsider its decision supporting the state's recent $2.8 billion pension bond sale, the Star Ledger reported Thursday.
The court ruled in a 5-2 decision on June 30 that the bond deal did not need approval from voters, but Spadoro asked the court for a rehearing.
The Mayor said he is concerned that the ruling would set a precedent allowing future governors to use borrowing to plug budget gaps.
Gov. Christine Whitman used the bond deal to eliminate the state pension system's unfunded liability. But the move also freed up about $590 million of one-shot budget savings.
